# Test fixtures

Fixtures are generated by seeded scripts and never hand-edited. Real or identifiable
subject data must never be committed.

Planned (see docs/plan.md, Gate 2):

- `two_analyte_pk.csv`: two analytes with overlapping subject and time keys, BLQ and
  exclusion examples, duplicate rows, mixed concentration units and one deliberately
  invalid row. Generated by `tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.R` (seeded).
- Reused from makecoolplots (copied with their generator, not hand-edited):
  `messy_generic.csv`, `adpc*.csv`, `sparse_*.csv`, `theoph_opnca.csv`.
